name: ztimed_task_remove_from_active_list
description: zTimedTask::RemoveFromActiveList unlinks a task from the global active list, updates count and tail for non-head removals, and leaves missing tasks unchanged.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja HLIL at 0x4bd470 shows active-head traversal, missing-task no-op, head removal through g_zTimedTask_ActiveHead = activeHead->next and count decrement, non-head unlink, tail update when the removed node is the tail, and no tail update on head removal.
The native timed-task smoke verifies middle removal, missing-task preservation, tail removal, and the original head-removal behavior where the tail is not corrected when the head path returns early.
